overview_description.description:
Tint is an AI-empowered insurance platform that provides tools required to launch, manage, and optimize insurance programs.

The platform helps companies maximize the profitability of their insurance programs while improving customer experience. Its API-based technology provides the infrastructure and AI models required to launch, manage, and improve any P&C insurance program. It is production-ready and saves months of engineering and data science resources involved in building real-time risk selection and pricing software required in modern insurance programs.

In 2018, Jérôme Selles, Nathan Barraille, and Matheus Riolfi started the company in San Francisco, California.
